verdict.rationale: Mercury exposes a documented REST API (transactions, AR, OAuth2, webhooks) and explicitly supports AI-agent consumption via llms.txt and markdown-formatted docs, which is validated by a live probe. However, there is no evidence of official client SDKs (e.g., Python/JS libraries), and the probe found the actual OpenAPI spec file (openapi.json) returning 404 despite docs claiming OpenAPI format, indicating gaps in formal SDK/spec availability.
